Match its hand-painted watercolor texture and believable painted volume, while keeping this object's own material and local colors. Chinese ink and restrained watercolor, thin varied grey-brown contours, low-saturation pigments, subtle directional brushwork following the form. Quiet matte surfaces under broad diffuse illumination. Solid volume through gently separated light, middle and shadow planes of the LOCAL COLOR. Lighter strokes are muted pigment on the object, never reflected light spots. Clear silhouette and few readable material features for small inventory display. No self-emission, bloom, aura, halo, rim lighting, white edge streaks, specular hotspots, sparkles, glossy reflections, glassy droplets, plastic or frosted 3D rendering. No flat vector shapes, thick cartoon outline, photographic noise or dense tiny scratches. TRUE ALPHA TRANSPARENCY outside the physical silhouette; no backdrop, floor, cast shadow, frame, lettering or interface. Exactly ONE complete object, fully inside canvas with about 6 percent even safe margin. Never reproduce the brown/black preview background of the reference. Subject: One compact firm fungal sclerotium, rounded and irregular with a damp brown outer rind; a small natural broken face reveals tightly packed layered fungal tissue. The interior is dense and solid. Compose upright within a 2:2 canvas. Final inventory footprint 2x2, packed dimensions 256x256. Keep the material compact, complete and recognizable with broad calm local-color planes, no scenery or extra props.
